text:
maria: Morning - noticed recurring p95 spikes in eu-west-3 during warm-cache windows, appears tied to NVLink retransmits + egress queuing.

alex: Yep, rack-12 nodes show simultaneous qdepth and thermal micro-caps. Looks like many mid-size prefix-gen jobs aligning.

jamal: Is it mostly shared-tenants or dedicated?

maria: Shared. No single noisy tenant - rather alignment of many warmups.

kevin: Trace sample req=tx-warm-21 shows ~120ms enqueued at egress proxy, and kernel logs show brief pci link resets during the burst.

olga: Can you share the promql for the charts?

kevin: Sure: max_over_time(egress_proxy_queue_len{region="eu-west-3"}[5m]) by (node) and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le,node)).

alex: Quick mitigation idea: create tiny ephemeral "warmup-silo" (2 GPUs) and steer warmup traffic there with an egress soft-cap so it can't thrash shared egress.

j amal: How do we mark warmup traffic? Caller header X-Warmup=1 for now. Long term add a detector: kv_miss_rate delta + prefix_length > threshold.

maria: Agreed header for canary rollback simplicity. Jamal please make allocation class warmup-silo-ephemeral with TTL 8m in staging eu3.

jamal: Will do. Labeling 3 staging nodes gpu_silo=warmup and creating class now.

kevin: I ran a short replay against staging: egress p95 down ~50%, NVLink retransmits down ~60%, median unchanged, overall token/sec down ~3% (expected due to shaping).

olga: SRE-bot: create alert warmup-silo-pressure (slack only) with 3m burn-in.

sre-bot: Alert warmup-silo-pressure created, severity warning, paging disabled.

alex: Rollout plan: 1) add node labels in eu-west-3, 2) proxy route matcher header->pool warmup-silo with qos weight 0.25 and token-bucket egress cap, 3) canary 5% warmup traffic for 30m, monitor egress_q_len, nvlink_err_rate, token throughput and cost.

maria: Rollback gates: region_egress_p95 > baseline*1.5 OR nvlink_err_rate > 2x baseline OR warmup-silo-queue_len > 120 for >2m.

kevin: Add per-slice egress_p95 and per-route token_rate to console before canary so PMs can see customer impact.

olga: I'll file finance ticket to set a cost cap and mark mini-silo nodes neutral for trial.

j amal: Allocation class created in staging, labels applied, replay uploaded to perf jobs.

maria: Kicking off 5% canary now. Will post results and escalate if rollback triggers hit.

alex: Follow-up: phase 2 implement in-proxy detector and consider NIC qdisc fallback if proxy shaping is insufficient.

maria: Thanks team. Keep alerts loud in #eng-oncall during the canary.
